title: Public-read storage ACL — review required
description: A storage access-control setting grants public-read, so bucket or object contents are readable by anyone on the internet, including backups, logs, and data exports. This lexical rule flags the ACL value; the reviewer confirms no sensitive object inherits it.
remediation: Use private ACLs and grant access through signed URLs or bucket policies scoped to exact principals. Enable Block Public Access and audit existing objects for inherited grants.
limitation: Lexical: matches the public-read value only; equivalent exposure through bucket policies, IAM, or presigned-URL misuse is out of scope.
